name: llmwiki-limited-isolation-backend
description: LIMITED-ISOLATION experiment backend for llmwiki (v1): wraps a provider child process with network-deny and scratch-write confinement via seatbelt (macOS) or bubblewrap (Linux), fail-closed when the tool is unavailable. NOT a security sandbox — env/FD/process/tree-kill isolation is UNENFORCED. Opt-in only; for code the operator wrote or trusts.
